csv_project_name: Engineering for 1104 to 1110 W. Main Structural Buildings
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Blue Springs, Missouri (hereafter referred to as the City ) is seeking proposals from qualified structural engineering firms to perform a comprehensive structural investigation and assessment of the buildings located at 1104 W. Main Street through 1110 W. Main Street, Blue Springs, Missouri 64015. The purpose of this investigation is to obtain detailed information regarding the structural systems, concealed building components, material types and conditions, and overall building integrity to assist the City in evaluating potential renovation, adaptive reuse, redevelopment, and occupancy options for the properties.
